name: Roberts Projects LA
about_text: Roberts Projects is a Los Angeles gallery representing mid-career and established artists alongside emerging talents from multiple generations and continents. Founded in 1999 as Roberts & Tilton by Bennett Roberts, Julie Roberts and Jack Tilton, the gallery renamed itself Roberts Projects in 2018 after Tilton's death. It has occupied three homes in Los Angeles: the Miracle Mile's 6150 complex, a converted coffee-roasting factory in Culver City, and since 2023 a restored 1948 automobile showroom on La Brea Avenue. The program favors museum-quality, installation-based exhibitions across drawing, painting, sculpture, photography, film and performance, periodically staging historical survey shows, and includes a publishing division producing artist monographs and catalogues.
